## Hackathon & Hacktoberfest Guidelines Checklist
Please review and check each item before opening this Pull Request:
- [ ] **Claimed Issue:** I commented on and claimed the target issue before starting work.
- [ ] **Single Issue Scope:** This PR addresses exactly ONE issue (no bundling multiple issues into one PR).
- [ ] **Anti-Spam & Quality Rule:** This PR contains meaningful code and tests. It is not a duplicate, junk, or typo-only contribution.
- [ ] **AI Assistance:** AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) are allowed and welcomed. If AI tools were used, the code has been reviewed, understood, and tested by the author.
- [ ] **Tests & Linting:** All new code includes unit tests and passes `npm run lint` and `npm test`.
